subject: FinTechCo deployment: follow-up on deployment mode & integration constraints
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechCo — post-demo recap & next steps (deployment mode)

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and a few follow-ups to help us recommend the right deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private):

Summary:
- Your primary constraints: SSO for product access, customer-managed KMS/HSM for key control, and long-term logging retention for audit (7+ years).
- Initial usage profile: ~50k requests/month with spiky traffic around batch processing windows.
- Data sensitivity: payment metadata + PII in prompt context; SOC 2 + regional data residency considerations.

Questions / asks to confirm:
1) For SSO — do you need IdP-initiated SSO only, or do you also require SCIM for user provisioning?
2) For key management — do you require HSM-backed CMKs in your own KMS (e.g., AWS KMS with CloudHSM), or is customer-managed keys in a supported cloud KMS sufficient?
3) Logging retention — is 7 years a hard requirement for all logs, or just audit trails? Any archival/storage preference (GCS/AWS S3 with lifecycle)?

Next steps we propose:
- Share a short matrix today that maps your constraints to recommended deployment (expected: Dedicated for isolation + KMS customer-managed; Private VPC/on-prem if HSM + air-gapped is mandatory).
- Loop in our solutions engineer (Rishi) and security SME (Dev) for a short technical call if you confirm SCIM or HSM requirements.

I attached a one-pager on KMS options and the filled SOC2 questionnaire you started — let me know if anything there is off.

Best,
—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: FinTechCo — post-demo recap & next steps (deployment mode)

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our security/product side:

- SSO: We need both IdP-initiated SSO and SCIM-based provisioning (we want automated onboarding/deprovisioning).
- KMS/HSM: Our compliance team is asking for HSM-backed keys controlled by us. Prefer CloudHSM-backed CMKs in AWS KMS, but we're open to alternatives if you support bringing our HSM or on-prem HSM connectors.
- Logging: Audit logs (access, admin actions) need 7+ years retention. Application logs can be archived to S3 with lifecycle rules.

Also want to confirm whether Dedicated gives us the ability to attach our own KMS and whether you support customer-managed HSM (or if that pushes us to Private).

Happy to take a brief technical call — suggest tomorrow morning.

Cheers,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo — post-demo recap & next steps (deployment mode)

Alex — thanks, that helps a lot. Looping in Rishi (Solutions Eng) and Dev (Security/Infrastructure) to address the HSM/SCIM specifics and confirm which deployment mode fits best given your constraints.

Quick notes to set expectations before the call:
- Dedicated: We support customer-managed keys in cloud KMS (AWS KMS with CMKs) and can configure it so Redwood does not have access to plaintext keys. For CloudHSM-backed CMKs, there are a few integration steps; Rishi can outline.
- Private VPC / On-prem: Required if you need an air-gapped environment or direct HSM appliance attachment; this option also provides the tightest network controls and full control over logging pipelines.
- SCIM & SSO: Both are supported for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted (multi-tenant hosted API) we support SAML SSO for console access but SCIM/automated provisioning and attaching customer KMS are limited — that's typically why customers with HSM requirements choose Dedicated or Private.

Action items before the technical call:
- Alex/Priya: Can you share an example CloudHSM architecture or the compliance note that mandates HSM-backed keys? That will let Dev advise whether Dedicated + CloudHSM is feasible or if Private is required.
- Marissa: I'll schedule a 45-min technical call with Rishi + Dev. Proposed times: Thu 11:00am PST / Thu 2:00pm EST or Fri morning.

I'll attach the KMS options doc again and a short matrix mapping constraints->deployment.


Marissa

Attachments: redwood-kms-options.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@fintechco.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cloud-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCo — post-demo recap & next steps (deployment mode)

Hi Alex / team — quick technical notes from my side after reviewing the asks:

1) CloudHSM-backed CMKs in AWS KMS:
- We can integrate Dedicated with customer-provided CMKs that are CloudHSM-backed, but there are operational steps: you will need to provision a CloudHSM cluster in your account and grant Redwood a limited IAM role to use the CMK for envelope encryption. Redwood does not have access to the HSM private keys.
- Network connectivity: network peering or a PrivateLink endpoint is required so the Dedicated pool can reach your KMS endpoint securely.

2) SCIM / SSO:
- Full SCIM provisioning + SAML/OIDC SSO supported on Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, SAML is available for the console only; SCIM/automated provisioning is limited.

3) Logging retention & audit:
- We can configure audit log streaming to your S3/GCS destination with lifecycle rules you control. For Dedicated, we retain structured audit logs for 7+ years by forwarding to your storage. Private gives you the option to keep logs fully within your VPC/on-prem for compliance.

Recommendation: Given the HSM-backed CMK requirement + SCIM need + 7-year audit retention, Dedicated with CloudHSM integration is likely feasible and is the least disruptive path. Private would be necessary only if your compliance team requires physical HSM appliance attachment or an air-gapped environment.

Proposed next steps:
- Technical call: Thu 11:00am PST (as Marissa suggested). I'll bring a checklist of required infra components (CloudHSM cluster, IAM role, VPC peering/PrivateLink endpoints, S3 bucket for audit logs).
- Pre-call doc: I'll share a short integration checklist (I attached redwood-kms-options.pdf).


Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Confirming the technical call for Thu 11:00am PST. I'll share the CloudHSM architecture and the compliance note by EOD today.
